args: import requests; import json; import sys; import time; data = json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); max_retries = 3; for attempt in range(max_retries): try: response = requests.post('http://your-server-host:8080/mcp/', json=data, timeout=30); response.raise_for_status(); print(json.dumps(response.json())); break; except Exception as e: time.sleep(1); if attempt == max_retries - 1: print(json.dumps({'error': {'code': 'CONNECTION_ERROR', 'message': str(e)}})); sys.exit(1)
